legend: Every value is measured by a script in scripts/ unless its key ends in _estimated or the value object has "estimated": true. Positions/sizes are % of frame width (x) / height (y). Times in seconds unless _ms.

format.note: render at 1920x1080/30 (Hyperframes default); every coordinate below is resolution independent

story_format (video-4).note: same channel, longer narrative entries; use when the script is a story list, not a ranking

rules: Cut on a word boundary (75% of cuts land within 250 ms of a word start/end); prefer the first stressed content word of a new clause.
One new visual per 3-4 spoken words in tier-list mode (153 wpm / 33 cpm = 4.6 words per shot, median shot 1.56 s).
Never hold a non-graphic shot longer than 5 s unless it is a clip playing its own audio (VO-off).
Tier chart holds and clip-audio shots are the only long shots (p90 2.9 s; the 5 s+ shots were all clip audio or chart).
pacing.detector: scdet score>=12, or 8-12 confirmed by PySceneDetect AdaptiveDetector; calibrated by eye: >=12 is 94% precise, 8-12 unconfirmed only 44%

hook.pattern: "From <extreme A> to <extreme B>, this is the <Topic> Tier List." spoken over 3-4 fast b-roll shots of the most extreme items (shots 1.6/1.4/1.0/2.5 s), ending on the title card over the empty tier chart.
hook.then: Immediately the first entry, no channel intro, no 'welcome back'. The first two entries are rapid (7 s and 9 s each: name -> one fact -> verdict) to establish the loop before the first deep dive (~70 s).

entry_template: 1. NAME BEAT: clip/photo of the person, typewriter name label beside the head, synced to the spoken name.
2. CAR/ITEM BEAT: footage of the item, price badge pops in top-left on the first shot of the item and stays for every shot of that item.
3. FACT BEATS: 1 visual per clause; spec captions (icon + lowercase text) bottom-centre for numbers; parenthetical asides as labels; screenshots for news.
4. OPTIONAL CLIP: the narrator sets up a quote, then the person's own clip plays with its audio (VO-off), lowercase subtitles.

5. VERDICT: hard cut to tier chart, music drops out on the tier letter, cursor drags the face into the column, "<X>-tier." spoken, hit + music back ~0.4 s into 'tier', hold ~0.8 s, hard cut to next entry.
structure.rhythm: alternate deep dives (60-100 s) with rapid-fire clusters (3 verdicts in 11 s at 700-711 s); open with two rapid entries

re_hook_cadence_s.basis: every verdict is a re-hook; median entry length 59.9 s

structure.ending_pattern_estimated: last entry is the biggest (God/S tier) collection; video ends on the final verdict + full chart, no outro card (only the last ~2 min were visible; marked estimated)
structure.sponsor_slot_estimated: video-4 has an integrated sponsor read at ~15:00-16:00 with the sponsor's UI screenshots; skill leaves a placeholder only if the user supplies sponsor copy

vignette_share_of_shots.rule: dark vignette on clips that carry subtitles and on archival footage; light/white vignette on article screenshots placed on white

inset_on_blur_or_black.rule: vertical or 4:3 source: centre it at full height, fill the sides with a blurred, darkened copy (blur ~40px, brightness 0.6) or black

ken_burns.ease: linear (no visible ease within a 1.5 s shot)
ken_burns.note: measured by optical flow, includes in-camera moves; apply to stills only: scale 1.00->1.11 over the shot, 60% push-in / 40% pull-out

treatments.snap_zoom_estimated: zoom-out from a photo to reveal it is inside an article screenshot (seen at 55.4 s); ~0.3 s, ease-out

color_grade.rule: no global grade; footage keeps its source look. Screenshots are shown bright on white with vignette.

treatments.borders: red 4px frame border on a clip used as a 'callout' (rare, 0.2%)

font.family: Arimo (metric clone of Arial; reference is Arial/Helvetica regular)
font.file: components/fonts/arimo-latin-*.woff2 (SIL OFL 1.1, from @fontsource/arimo); handwritten annotations: Kalam 700 (OFL)

text.case: all lowercase for labels, captions and subtitles; Title Case only inside price-badge model names and the tier chart title
text.stroke_shadow: white fill, 1.5px dark outline rgba(0,0,0,0.75) + soft shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) (estimated from crops)

name_label.pattern: <first last> lowercase, wrapped to one word per line when beside a head; parentheses for a person mentioned in passing: "(rowan atkinson)"
name_label.position: beside the subject's head, text block centre at y 35-45%, on the empty side of the frame (x 30% or 62%)
name_label.anchor: right-aligned when left of the head, left-aligned when right of it
name_label.entrance: typewriter, ~35 chars/s (14 chars in 0.4 s), plus slow drift 1.5% of width per second

spec_caption.pattern: <number> <unit> | <short fact>, lowercase ("620 horsepower", "no driver aids", "no power steering")
spec_caption.icon: cut-out side view of the current car, height 7% H, 0.6% W gap left of text

subtitle_clip_audio.pattern: lowercase chunks of 2-5 words, no punctuation, one key word in red #e0262b when the line has a punchline
subtitle_clip_audio.entrance: pop per chunk on the word

aside_label.pattern: free text placed on the object, can be rotated to the object's angle ("1 of 64 Mclaren" at -15 deg); arrow + label for 'you'

title_card.pattern: "<Topic> Tier List" white Title Case centred on the grass band of the opening chart

big_number.pattern: "805 horsepower"/"$1M" large on the subject, rotated to match it

tier_chart.letters: black, bold, 6% H, centred in header
tier_chart.background: top-down aerial road (two lanes) with grass verges; unranked faces wait on the road lanes as white-outlined sticker cutouts, 7.5% H
tier_chart.faces: head cutouts, 4px white sticker outline + drop shadow, ranked faces sit in the column body in rows of 3-4
tier_chart.animation: a mouse cursor drags the face from its lane into the column over ~0.25 s (ease-out), face lands, chart holds ~0.8 s after the verdict word, hard cut out

price_badge.content: car cutout (left, 43% of box width), price bold white 4.4% H ("$300K", "~$10M" when estimated), model name 1.6% H bold white below the price
price_badge.entrance: hard pop on the first frame of the item's first shot
price_badge.persistence: stays on every shot of that item, removed on the cut to anything else
price_badge.sfx: short bright tick on entrance in 49% of cases (centroid ~5.5 kHz, peak +60 ms, decay 0.2 s)

face_grid_tracker (story format).layout: 2 rows x 12 faces, bottom 20% of frame, square portrait tiles on pink #f2b6c9 background; upcoming people are black silhouettes; current pair outlined red #e0262b
face_grid_tracker (story format).with: pair title "<a> x <b>" white lowercase above the grid; hero cutouts of the pair face-to-face over a coloured smoke background
face_grid_tracker (story format).appears: at the start of every new pair (chapter marker)

screenshot_card.rule: article/tweet screenshot centred on white (articles) or black (tweets), heavy vignette, key sentence highlighted (yellow #ffe14d marker or red #e0262b box with white text)

map.rule: satellite top-down + red map pin dropping onto the place

silhouette_reveal.rule: black silhouette of the item + white number on it before the reveal

logo_on_black.rule: brand logo centred on black, ~22% H

annotated_meme.rule: hand-drawn yellow #ffe14d or white arrow + label ("you", "mr beast") on footage, handwritten bold font

others.type: zoom-out reveal (photo -> article it came from)

transitions.sfx_on_cuts: no: SFX hit-rate at plain cuts 22-24% = random-time baseline 20%

vo.eq_rule: highpass 80 Hz, no presence boost; warm/low-mid heavy

pauses_vocal_stem.method: silencedetect -38 dB, >=0.3 s, on demucs vocal stems of 8x40 s windows
pauses_vocal_stem.rule: narration is cut tight (no pause >0.22 s inside the VO); the only real pauses are deliberate 0.55 s breaths after verdicts/punchlines (~4/min)

music.ducking_rule: NONE: the bed sits constantly ~10 LU under the VO; it is not raised in VO gaps
music.genre_estimated: upbeat instrumental beat (hip-hop/trap-pop), 115-125 BPM, not identified by ear

verdict_dropout.rule: music hard-cuts out on the tier letter (digital silence in 44% of verdicts, 0.05-1.95 s), returns with a hit 0.4-0.5 s after 'tier' starts

music_or_sfx_gap.rule: breath gap after a punchline/fact: 0.45 s of bed only, never filled

clip_speech.rule: when the script quotes/sets up a person ('as soon as you turn 16', 'it only ends one way'), cut to the person's clip; clip audio starts on the cut (median offset <=200 ms), hard switch (<=50 ms fade), music bed continues under it, lowercase subtitles, VO resumes hard on the cut back

digital_silence.rule: used only for the verdict dropout and once for a comedic beat (0.82 s after 'Mr. Bean crashed his McLaren F1')

vo_off.speaker_split: resemblyzer embeddings; narrator threshold ~0.70 cosine + lone-short-line rule; ~3/30 borderline lines may be mislabelled

per_minute_estimated.basis: 53 badge entrances x 0.49 + 16 verdicts x 0.75 + 41 vignette entrances x 0.41 over 16.8 usable min

rules: SFX peak lands 30-60 ms after its visual (never before)
